name: solidity-lean
description: Run kernel-checked Solidity verification and inspect obligations, diagnostics and proof status.

solidityLean.backendPath.description: Solidity Lean repository directory. Empty uses the Solidity file's workspace folder.

solidityLean.nodePath.description: Node.js executable used to launch verification.

solidityLean.verifyOnSave.description: Verify Solidity files automatically when saved.

solidityLean.automaticVerification.description: When the persistent language server verifies document snapshots. verifyOnSave overrides this setting with onsave.

solidityLean.workers.description: Maximum concurrent verification workers per backend configuration. Each worker keeps a Lean session alive.

solidityLean.displayGutterStatus.description: Show current-version verification status beside function declarations.

solidityLean.counterexamples.description: Search for kernel-certified model prestates when a verification goal stays open. Refutations describe the verification model; they do not establish constructor reachability.

solidityLean.auditPreconditions.description: Also check whether specified functions have a possible entry state. Impossible or unknown audits require attention even when the postcondition is proved.
